result.title: DiffGround: Semantic Difference-Guided Zero-Shot Video Question Grounding
result.comment: This paper is accepted by ACCV 2026. We plan to publicly release the source code at https://github.com/steven413d/DiffGround
result.summary: Video Question Grounding (VideoQG) requires both accurate question answering and precise temporal localization. Existing supervised methods rely on costly temporal annotations, while existing zero-shot approaches are primarily designed for Video Question Answering (VQA) and are not optimized for temporal grounding. We propose DiffGround, an action-driven zero-shot framework built upon frozen Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Our framework first predicts an answer-relevant action cue that transforms the input question into an explicit semantic target for grounding. Action Cue converts a reasoningoriented question into an action-centric retrieval query. Guided by the action cue, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) efficiently selects informative keyframes for reasoning. Finally, we introduce Semantic Diff Refinement, a training-free temporal refinement method that exploits semantic differences between neighboring SigLIP2 embeddings to recover complete action segments from sparse predictions. Extensive experiments on NExT-GQA and STAR show that DiffGround consistently outperforms existing zero-shot and supervised methods, establishing a new state of the art for Video Question Grounding.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DiffGround：基于冻结 MLLM 的零样本视频问答定位框架，先用 action cue 把问题转成动作检索目标并据此让 VLM 选关键帧，再用免训练的 Semantic Diff Refinement 依据相邻 SigLIP2 嵌入差异从稀疏预测中恢复完整动作片段，在 NExT-GQA 与 STAR 上评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 领域较远（视频时序定位），但其 cue 引导的关键帧筛选可视为视觉证据筛选线索，用相邻嵌入语义差异扩展稀疏证据的做法或与 latent 相似度中内容/位置因素的考察有关，可供核查。
